about: Who a style change in the page editor reaches, in the order offered. A scope takes the selected part alone (no match), the parts picked on the canvas (picked: true; shift-click picks several), or every part on the page whose facts equal the selected part's for each fact in match. A fact is tag (the element's name), class (its classes, in any order) or any attribute's name, such as data-trillion-element, every element's address.
